_about: Reviews copied word for word from DocNova's Google Business Profile, shown on the site until the live Google connection (GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY) is set up. Once it is, live reviews replace these automatically. Keep text exactly as written on Google, and update rating/count when they change.

reviews.author: ABIOLA KEHINDE
reviews.text: Really happy with these scrubs! They fit really well, feel comfortable, and look great. The quality is excellent and they’re perfect for long shifts. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Ai Hassan
reviews.text: Exceptional quality and fitting! Keep coming back for more and rewards system is an absolute joy. Best in the market amongst the competitors

reviews.author: Maria Abbasi
reviews.text: I absolutely love these scrubs! They are incredibly comfortable, and I get so many compliments on both the color and the fit every time I wear them. The multiple pockets are a huge plus—they're perfect for keeping everything I need close by during a busy workday. I've owned scrubs from another popular brand, but these are by far the best. The comfort, quality, fit, and functionality are outstanding. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for scrubs that look great and perform even better!

reviews.author: Khulood H
reviews.text: Amazing! The quality is better than Figs and I am so impressed by their customer service!! I’m their loyal customer now and everyone at the hospital loves their scrubs too

reviews.author: manzoor
reviews.text: Amazing quality products, genuine care for customers. Ordered the blood pressure machine for my dad it works better than any normal ones. Looking forward to being a returning customer!

reviews.author: Alishba Fatima
reviews.text: Great experience! Professional service, quality products, and fast response. Highly recommended.
